ingredients.originalText: Sherry or regular white wine (you cook with what you drink with!) (1 tablespoon)

instructions.title: Original step 1
instructions.description: Cut broccoli into little flourettes (hold the broccoli upside down and cut around the stem with a pairing knife)

instructions.title: Original step 2
instructions.description: Fill your pan (or wok) around half inch (1.57cm) with water and bring to a rapid boil.

instructions.title: Original step 3
instructions.description: Put broccoli in and steam with lid on for approx. 3 minutes.

instructions.title: Original step 4
instructions.description: Drain broccoli and wipe pan dry.

instructions.title: Original step 5
instructions.description: One teaspoon of oil and saute garlic and ginger (use sesame seed oil for Asian touch, but neutral or olive oil works well too).

instructions.title: Original step 6
instructions.description: Deglaze with sherry, put half a cup (approx 120 ml) of warm water or chicken stock. Reduce on medium-high heat.

instructions.title: Original step 7
instructions.description: Stir in soy sauce, brown sugar and lemon juice to your taste.

instructions.title: Original step 8
instructions.description: Thicken sauce with corn starch.

instructions.title: Original step 9
instructions.description: Put dry cooked broccoli back in and saute for very short time (you want it nice and crunchy).

title: 奶油蘑菇意面
description: Based Cooking 开放授权教程；原始步骤和用量保持来源内容。

ingredients.originalText: 8 oz uncooked pasta (spaghetti or any other long noodle will work. Stroganov can also be served over rice.)
12 oz mushrooms (I reccommend shitake, but white, portabello, or maitake will also work.)

ingredients.ingredientId: unknown:4 Tbsp creme fraiche (can be made by mixing equal parts heavy and sour cream)
ingredients.originalText: 4 Tbsp creme fraiche (can be made by mixing equal parts heavy and sour cream)

instructions.title: Original step 1
instructions.description: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta al dente

instructions.title: Original step 2
instructions.description: In a cup, combine flour, mustard, smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Add broth and whisk until no lumps remain.

instructions.title: Original step 3
instructions.description: While pasta is cooking, melt butter in a medium skillet and over medium heat.

instructions.title: Original step 4
instructions.description: When the butter is melted, add onions and cook until softened.

instructions.title: Original step 5
instructions.description: Add mushrooms and cook until all water evaporates and mushrooms are slightly browned, about 7 minutes.

instructions.title: Original step 6
instructions.description: Add garlic and cook for another 30 seconds.

instructions.title: Original step 7
instructions.description: Pour the flour and broth mixture into the mushrooms and cook until thickens, about 2 minutes.

instructions.title: Original step 8
instructions.description: Stir in Creme Fraiche.

instructions.title: Original step 9
instructions.description: Add the strained pasta to the mushroom sauce and stir to coat the pasta completely.

instructions.title: Original step 10
instructions.description: Serve immediately.
